allowed.entry:src/main.tsx: the browser entry point the app shell build bundles from index.html; nothing imports it.
allowed.entry:src/worker/service-worker.ts: the service worker is compiled by packages/app/scripts/build-release.ts from this path and registered by URL; nothing imports it.
allowed.entry:scripts/**/*.ts: the app shell build scripts (build-release, build-fy-render-libs) are run by path from package.json scripts; nothing imports them.
allowed.ignore:tests/support/dom-leak-guard.ts: a bun test preload named by path in bunfig.unit.toml; nothing imports it.
allowed.entry:src/theme/packs/*/*/*.ts: a theme pack (a palette, style or font folder) is listed by the generator into the git-ignored src/generated/theme-packs.ts (scripts/gen/registries.ts), which knip does not read, so each pack file is an entry by its folder: a new pack adds a folder and edits no list (docs/standards/architecture). Not a pending-port gap.
